title: The Cellar of Cold Spring
author: Xanthe Vane
blurb: Wren Underhill, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, has spent seven years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
